view_patch:
--- view
+++ view
@@ -30,5 +30,5 @@
     jq -ce --arg rev "$rev" --arg file "$file" 'if .revision==$rev then {name:.definition,$file,body:.selection.expanded} else error("project revision changed") end'
 done | jq -sc . > "$w/forms"
 view=$(jq -c --slurpfile forms "$w/forms" '.+{forms:$forms[0]}' "$w/packet")
-"$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/grouped_view.tide" --call compiler_view --inputs "$view" > "$w/grouped"
+"$repo/tide" run "$repo/workbench/grouped_view.tide" --call "${5:-compiler_view}" --inputs "$view" > "$w/grouped"
 stamp > "$w/end"
